title: Autumn Sutra — Temple of the Nine Rings
description: A Japanese Buddhist temple garden: a seated golden Buddha in the open hondo, three sweeping pagoda roofs beneath a nine-ring sorin, and a novice tending incense beside the maple-shadowed pond bridge.
